source_title: Pic-Me – Fly to the Locations Where Users Send Posts, HeK Basel, Marc Lee
desc_src: With Pic-me you can virtually fly to the locations from where users send randomly selected posts to Instagram, thus creating another view on how the media handles posts on social networks. One might describe these posts – images or short videos accompanied by comments, tags and geolocalization – as a kind of digital small talk or personal conversation. Different than face to face conversations, these fleeting thoughts are accumulated and archived by governments, corporations, and research institutes and then transformed into everlasting stories as well. We can’t tell yet, what the consequences…

Photographic work “Light Circle”, first exhibited in 2013 at the photography exhibition “Kreativ.anders” at Freizeitheim Linden in Hanover. The image shows an abstract circular light form against a black background. Several semi-transparent, overlapping arcs of red, pink, and violet light create a dynamic inward-moving circle, with the left side of the frame remaining mostly dark.
